aboutText: With over 15 years of experience serving the Hallam community, Totally Outdoors has built a reputation for reliable and high-quality pergola and outdoor structures. Our team is dedicated to transforming your outdoor space with durable and stylish designs tailored to your needs. We pride ourselves on timely completion and exceptional customer service, making us the trusted choice for homeowners across Melbourne's southeast.
servicesText: At Totally Outdoors, we offer a comprehensive range of outdoor solutions, from pergolas to full outdoor rooms. Our services are designed to maximise your space and provide year-round enjoyment. Each project is completed with attention to detail and using premium materials.

services.name: Pergolas & Carports
services.desc: We design and build custom pergolas and carports to protect your vehicles and enhance your outdoor aesthetic, using durable materials suited for Australian conditions.

services.name: Verandahs & Patios
services.desc: Create a comfortable outdoor entertaining area with our verandah and patio installations, perfect for relaxing in Hallam's backyard settings.

services.name: Roofing Systems
services.desc: Install advanced louvre and insulated roof systems to provide shade and weather protection, ensuring year-round comfort in your outdoor space.

services.name: Outdoor Rooms & Decking
services.desc: Expand your living area with fully enclosed outdoor rooms and stylish decking, designed for versatility and durability in Melbourne's climate.

services.name: Blinds, Shutters & Screens
services.desc: Add privacy and control light with our range of blinds, shutters, and screens, custom-fitted for pergolas and outdoor structures.

services.name: Custom & Commercial Projects
services.desc: From DIY assistance to large-scale commercial outdoor projects, we provide tailored solutions to meet diverse client needs in Hallam and beyond.
